title: Tenant-shield audit ingest + retention controller for RBAC v2 and SSO events
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement a tenant-shielded audit ingestion and retention controller focused on RBAC v2 and SSO/SAML admin events. This ticket covers ingest-side policing, sensitive-event classification, adaptive TTLs, cost-aware partitioning, and an index compaction schedule to keep audit storage economical while preserving compliance requirements. Key goals: (1) ensure privileged admin/SSO events are retained and indexed for fast lookup; (2) throttle and sample extremely high-volume tenants to prevent cross-tenant impact; (3) integrate with KMS/HSM-backed encryption and audit ledgering for tamper evidence; (4) provide operator playbooks for emergency retention extension and cross-region rehydration. The controller should operate as a stateless microservice with a small control plane state stored in the controller DB for per-tenant policies and leases. It must expose clear metrics and tracing to Console for per-tenant cost and SLO dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant retention policies configurable via Console and API with minimum/maximum TTL bounds
Sensitive event classification pipeline that tags admin/SSO/SAML events and routes them to hot index with 90-day default TTL
Adaptive TTL engine that reduces retention for noisy low-sensitivity tenants automatically based on ingestion budget and SLA tier
Partitioning scheme implemented: time + tenant-shield + sensitivity (hot/hot-cold/cold) with manifest for fast pruning
Backpressure and rate-limiting at ingress: tenant-level token bucket and sample-policy for >10k events/min
Cost accounting: token-level tokenization mapping events->cost and exported to Console as daily per-tenant cost-approx
Index compaction job that runs weekly to merge small segments and rewrite logs older than 7 days as compressed cold blobs
End-to-end encryption with KMS integration and verified rotation path; archived cold blobs are AES-256 with envelope keys
Canary rollout plan and automated rollback on error budgets or ingestion lag >30s
Documentation and runbook: upgrade/migration steps, incident playbook for missed retention or over-quota scenarios
notes: This approach favors tenant isolation: each tenant gets a 'shield' manifest referring to allowed ingestion rate, sensitivity thresholds, retention tier, and index shard affinity. We will reuse existing compact-indexing primitives from ENG-91012 and adapt the shard-ttl controller from ENG-41257. Coordinate with Platform Security for SAML attribute mapping and with Storage team for coldstore lifecycle policy.

implementation_plan: Phase 1 - API + manifest: Build tenant manifest API and Console settings for per-tenant retention, budget, and sensitivity mappings
Phase 2 - Ingest policing: Implement token-bucket rate limiter, sample policy, and enrichment layer to tag SSO/RBAC events
Phase 3 - Storage tiers: Implement partitioning by tenant-shield+sensitivity and integrate coldstore lifecycle with compaction jobs
Phase 4 - Adaptive TTL + billing: Add rule engine for TTL adjustments and wire cost accounting into Console
Phase 5 - Compliance hooks & encryption: Integrate KMS envelope encryption and tamper-evidence ledgering for privileged events
Phase 6 - Rollout & observability: Canary rollout, dashboards, alerting, and runbook publication
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-sampling can lead to missed forensics for regulated customers. Mitigation: Expose immutable override flags for Compliance and require two-person approval for reducing retention below policy thresholds

Risk: Tenant throttling causes user-visible delays in admin flows. Mitigation: Prefer sampling for low-sensitivity traffic and prioritized lanes for admin/SSO endpoints; burst capacity for critical flows
Risk: Index compaction IO spikes. Mitigation: Schedule compactions with IO capping and stagger per-shard windows; use low-priority background IO class
Risk: Key rotation/crypto complexity. Mitigation: End-to-end tests for rotation, and fallback to previous key for rehydration path; store rotation metadata in controller DB
qa_plan: Unit tests for manifest API and TTL rule evaluation
Load test with synthetic tenants at scale (10k tenants, mixed volume) to validate rate-limiting and sampling behavior
Compliance validation for retention windows and immutable overrides
Chaos scenario: simulate coldstore unavailability and verify rehydration and retention-extension playbook
Security audit of KMS integration and encryption-at-rest/in-transit checks
